verdict_A_source_repair.evidence: Active route graph review found 9 route scripts and 24 driver entry paths. The active Data member lookup and DELETE readers and auto-extract owned-row GET/PATCH reader use the shared versioned OAuth session reader. The request harness verifies bearer authorization, organization header, scoped row lookup and PATCH body.
verdict_A_source_repair.native_status: No hosted browser, current installed artifact, product behavior, Store build or release was verified.

verdict_B_doctrine_and_harness_quality.forcing_behavior: The active-route census detects a planted retired-key consumer. Request checks reject a retired-reader mutation and a skipped-fetch mutation. Auth summaries recognize current, absent, malformed and unsupported-version OAuth values while excluding bearer strings from serialized summaries. Request assertions verify authenticated GET/PATCH emissions, organization scope and expected results.
verdict_B_doctrine_and_harness_quality.old_code_red_evidence: The committed source run report records the three focused pre-fix tests failing 12 cases with only the current OAuth session seeded. I independently ran the pristine parent commit's corresponding tests; all 33 passed because those old tests still seed the retired key. Therefore the recorded current-session-only RED is not reproducible from the pristine parent fixture set alone. The committed retired-reader mutation guard does reject that behavior, but I did not reconstruct and rerun the pre-fix current-session-only fixture in a scratch tree.
verdict_B_doctrine_and_harness_quality.route_census_limits: The census excludes hosted profile dispatch because the runner explicitly refuses it, and preserves the D217 helper's deliberate retired-key absence check.

limits: The recorded pre-fix RED was not independently reconstructed with current-session-only fixtures against pristine old code.
